tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lus dkyil mdor bsdus dril bu zhabs kyi zhal lung

zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi lus dkyil mdor bsdus pa dril bu zhabs kyi zhal lung zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// gdod ma'i gnas lugs ma 'khrul ji lta bar// lam du bgyi tshe bskyed rdzogs gdams zab kyis// 'bras bu'i he ru ka dpal mngon byed pa// brgyud pa'i bshes gnyen tshogs kyis 'gro 'di srungs// de yang rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi snying po dpal mkha' 'gro ma dra ba sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyams su blang ba la'ang*/ mchog dang*/ phal pa gnyis las/ phyi ma ni rdul mtshon dang ras bris sogs yin zhing*/ snga ma ni grub chen dril bu zhabs kyis/ 'gro ba 'di nyid rang bzhin gyis// grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gdod ma nas rnal 'byor pa'i lus la rtsa khams dpa' bo dpa' mo'i rang bzhin du gnas pa dag /skabs 'dir lam du byas nas dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang bsgrub pa la gnyis/ sngon du bya ba dang*/ sgrub thabs dngos so// dang po la/ slob dpon mchog gi lus dkyil du dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas nangs par snga bar langs pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i zhu ba'i glu'am yi ge bdun pa'i sgras sad de bskul bar mos pas langs te/ dur khrod sogs rnal 'byor dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas rnams su/ ro'i stan la kha lhor phyogs shing skra bshig nas bde bar 'dug pa'i mdun du stegs kyi khar/ nas/ 'bras/ sbrang rtsi/ bu ram/ ka ra/ sgog btsong dang*/ chang*/ chu/ 'o mas sbags pa'i gtor ma zlum po pad 'dab kyis bskor ba rgyan dang ldan pa la/ nya sha sogs sha sna tshogs kyis bran pa dang*/ chu bzhi'i snod dung chen bzed zhal dang bcas pa dang*/ nyer spyod lnga dang*/ gzhan yang nang mchod bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i thod pa dang*/ ḍā ma ru/ rdo rje/ dril bu rnams kyang rang gi g.yon nas mgo brtsams te bsham/

phyogs skyong gi gtor ma gnyis sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang tshogs par bya/ rang gi mdun du bde mchog lha re gnyis kyi bris sku byin rlabs dang ldan pa'ang bsham/ gzhal yas khang dag kyang lha rdzas kyi reg byas brgyan par bya'o// tshogs dang gtor ma'i sha shi ba las bsad sha la mi bya ba sgron gsal dang dus 'khor las gsungs pa'ang zhi sogs gsum la shi ba kho na'i sha dang*/ drag po la bsad pa'i sha khrag dgos so// ye thig las/ gtor gdugs gzugs par bshad do// sgrub thabs dngos la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs gtor ma gtang*// mchod pa byin rlabs skyabs sems dang*// srung 'khor tshogs bsags stong nyid bsgom// dang po bdud rtsi la chu bran te/ bdud rtsi ril bu rang gi lcer bzhag pas kha dag pa'am| med na/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gsal bar gyur/ khaṇḍa ro hes bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dbus dang phyogs bzhir hūm̐ oṃ khaṃ aṃ trāṃ dang*/ bāṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ las bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lngar gyur pa rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ rlung gis bskyod/ me sbar zhing bskol bas sa bon dang bcas pa'i rdzas rnams zhu ba nyi ma 'char kha lta bu'i kha dog can/ de'i rlangs pa las grub pa'i dngul chu'i mdog dang mtshungs pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga kha 'og tu blta ba/ de nyid kyang zhu nas bcud dang dbyer med du 'dres pa'i steng du ā di kā di yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ steng nas steng du brtsegs te gnas pa las dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams spros/ sems can gyi don byas nas snyoms par zhugs pas yi ge gsum la thim/ yi ge gsum yang dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur/

ces bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyi lcer myangs/ gnyis pa sngon 'gro'i gtor ma gong ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ pad kor dang rdor thal kha phye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa/ rākṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ unmā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇantu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra yatstshantu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi ghra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shuddha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*| |ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin gsol// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// byad stems ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod// ces phrin las bcol zhing gtor ma gtsang sar dor/

gsum pa mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i nang du hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las mchod yon/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dgyes pa bskyed nus par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ oṃ badzra dang āḥhūm̐ sbyar te/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prokṣa ṇaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapad/ zhes so so'i sngags rgya rol mo dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab bo// bzhi pa skyabs sems ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo'i tshogs// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni he ru kar gyur cing*// sems can thams cad he ru ka'i// go 'phang mchog la 'god par bgyi// zhes gsum bya/ lnga pa bsrung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ shar du/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang du/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub tu/ oṃ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lhor/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi yi ge rnams g.yon skor du nag ljang dmar ser ba'i kha dog can tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar du khyab cing 'bar ba de'i 'od zer gyis rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi pa phyogs kyi mdog can du gyur/ 'og tu hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan ba las 'od 'phros pas sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang*/ rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can gyi mda'i dra ba dang*/

gur gyi nang du bla bre dang*/ phyi rol du rdo rje'i me dpung 'bar bas bar med du khyab par gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badzrī bha wa badzra bhandha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pra kā ra hūm̐ paṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pañdza ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes so// drug pa tshogs bsag pa ni/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi lus he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dbus su/ dpal mchog dang po'i yi ge hūm̐ sngon po'i 'od kyis sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas chos dbyings nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pa rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs 'od zer snying khar thim par gyur/ ces dmigs la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pā dyaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prokṣa ṇaṃ/ puṣpaṃ| dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapad/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badzra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ waṃ she/ mṛ taṃ ge/ mu rañdze/ hā sya/ lā sya/ gī ti/ nṛ tyai/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gandhe/ zhes dang*/ oṃ rū pa badzri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ ra sa/ sparshe/ dharma dhā tu/ zhes so so'i sngags rgya se gol dang bcas pas mchod/ slar nang mchod thigs gtor gyis/ oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ pad kor 'khyud pa'i rgyas/ oṃ shrī ma hā su kha he he ru ru kaṃ āḥhuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mchod la/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*// rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyis// rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud// gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing*// 'du dang dur khrod gnas pa yi// dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma// kun la bdag gis gus phyag 'tshal// zhes bstod/

rgyun bshags ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags/ 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi| |byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces gsum brjod/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ ces mos/ bdun pa stong nyid bsgom pa ni/ rang gi spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga rim pa bzhin du he ru ka zhes bya ba'i yi ge dkar dmar sngo ba'i kha dog can gsal bar gyur/ he ni bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis ka dang rgyu med las skye ba spangs pa/ ru ni gnas pa dang 'jig pa'i tshogs dang bral ba/ ka ni mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'o// de lta bu'i chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mi shes pa'i sems can rnams bdag dang bdag gi ba la sogs par yongs su bzung bas 'khor bar gyur to| |de bas na bdag he ru kar gyur nas gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i chos khong du chud par 'gyur ba de ltar don bya'o// oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyi sngags don dran pas/ khams gsum po thams cad rang bzhin mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid do// sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis sems nyid oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po'i rnam par brtsegs thabs su gnas pa las sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams spros/ 'gro ba thams cad 'khor lo gsum gyi lhar byas te snyoms par zhugs pas zhu ba yi ge gsum la so sor thim zhing de dag kyang steng nas rim gyis hūm̐ la bsdus/ de yang zhabs kyu/ khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da'i bar du 'dus te/ nā da yang shin tu phra ba mi dmigs par gyur/

oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes so/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la rtsa ba dang yan lag go// dang po ni/ rten dang brten bskyed dag pa dran// go bgo ye shes gzhug dbang bskur// rgyas gdab phyi nang gsang de nyid// sngags mchod bstod cing phreng byin rlabs// bzlas pa rdzogs rim bsdu chog go// dang po rten lus phyi'i he ru kar bskyed pa dang*/ de'i lus gzhal yas khang du bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'brur nyi ma dang 'jigs dus kyi gdan la rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi dbus dang sku mdog sngon po/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser ba'i zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing*/ 'jigs su rung ba'i zhal re re'i steng du rdo rje nag po'i phreng bas sbrel ba'i thod skam lnga lnga rin po che'i rtse bran gyis brgyan pa/ ral pa'i cod pan gyi rtse mor nor bu/ mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon du zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa mgo g.yas su phyogs pa'i lag pa dang rkang pa g.yon pa dag 'dzin pa/ g.yas gsum pas ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pas dgra sta/ lnga pas gri gug /drug pas tri shū la/ g.yon gsum pas kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhi pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pas rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pas tshangs mgo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo bltabs pa'i rna ba g.yon pa brdzis shing*/ g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i bar du mnan pa/ mi'i rgyu ma la brgyud pa'i mgo rlon khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rdo rje nor bus spras pa'i rus chen gyi 'khor lo/ rna cha/ mgul rgyan/

gdub kor/ mchod phyir thogs pa/ thal chen gyis byugs pa ste phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs rgyab nas mdun du mdud pa'i mgo brla g.yas su grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'i pang du yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum ma/ skra rgyab tu 'phyangs pa'i skra mtshams su rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyud pa'i thod skam lngas mtshan pa/ phyag gnyis kyi g.yon bdud kyi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thogs nas yab kyi zhal du stob cing*/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis gdug pa can thams cad la sdigs par mdzad pa/ zhabs kyi byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la legs par 'khyud cing bde ba'i nyams ldan gcer mo khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ sgeg cing lang tsho dar ba'i sku la thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal dang thod pa'i dum bu'i ska rags can rus chen gyi phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa yab yum gnyis ka mtshan dpes spras shing*/ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i gzi brjid can thabs shes gnyis su med par snyoms par zhugs pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ bdag nyid he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i rkang pa gnyis bgrad pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor sum mdo gru gsum me/ lto ba zlum po chu/ brang gru bzhi sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod cha/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi ni gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon gyi dbye bas zur bzhi| rlung lnga ni rtsig pa lnga/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba ni sgo bzhi/ sna rtse bzhi rta babs/ rgyu ma dra ba/ rgyus pa dra phyed/ so mda' yab/ dkar cha zla ba phyed pa/ mchu 'dod snam/ rkang brgyad ka ba brgyad/ mig gi rnam shes me long*/ rna ba'i rnam shes rol mo'i sgra/ sna'i rnam shes me tog gi phreng ba/ lce'i rnam shes rin chen pha gu/ lus kyi rnam shes dar 'phan/ yid kyi rnam shes ri dwags zung*/

mig 'khor lo/ rna ba kun nas rdo rje/ sna ba dan/ lce dril bu/ skra tshogs gdugs rgyal mtshan/ phung po lnga rnams phyogs kyi mdog can du dbye ba sogs gzhal yas khang gi rgyan thams cad ldan pa/ klad pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad 'dab so gnyis/ de nas rgyu ba'i rlung dang thig le ni dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge/ snying gar padma 'dab brgyad/ kha dang*/ nor bu'i sbubs/ mig gnyis/ sna dang*/ rna ba gnyis rnams kyi bu ga ni dur khrod brgyad/ pags pa rdo rje'i dra ba/ ba spu mda'i dra ba la ye shes lnga'i me 'bar zhing 'od 'phro ba rang gi lus gdod ma nyid nas dkyil 'khor du gnas pa'o// zhes gsal btab bo// gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa ni/ klad pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su haṃ yig dkar po rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid dga' bde'i sgras bskul ba las zhu ba dang ldang ba'i rim pas hūm̐ yig byang chub kyi sems gzhom med yungs 'bru'i tshad tsam kha ba lta bu 'dzag pa nyid 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i dbus a wa dhū ti'i nang du bab pa dang*/ gsang ba'i gnas su rgod ma'i me dang mtshungs pa'i dmar cha baṃ gyi rang bzhin dang snying gar phrad pa las bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi dbus dang sku mdog sngon po zhes pa nas/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i bar sngar ltar dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i mdun chu rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa māṃ las mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga /g.yon rlung gi rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa tāṃ las lā ma ljang gu/ rgyab me rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa pāṃ las dum skyes ma dmar mo/ g.yas sa rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa lāṃ las gzugs can ma ser mo/ bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig pa spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer mo skra grol ba/ thod pa'i dum bu'i ska rags can phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/

rdo rje'i phreng bar brgyud pa'i thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa'i gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pas gnas pa/ mtshams su bdud rtsi lnga 'bab pa'i rtsa bzhi ni bum pa'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba gnas pa rnams bde chen 'khor lo/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyer bzhir/ pū dzā o a gau ra de ma/ ka o tri ko ka laṃ ka hi/ pre gṛ sau su nā si ma ku/ de ltar yi ge nyer bzhi po brjod pas rten dang brten pa cig car du rdzogs pa ste/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyer bzhi po sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo dkar dmar sngo ba'i mdog can la de na gnas pa'i rtsa rnams dpa' mo dang*/ rtsa nang du 'bab pa'i khams rnams dpa' bor gyur pa ni/ spyi bor pūlli ra ma la yar so dang sen mo 'bab pa'i rtsa mi phyed ma thod pa'i dum bu dang rab gtum ma/ spyi gtsug dzā landha rar skra dang ba spu 'bab pa'i rtsa phra gzugs ma keng rus chen po dang gtum mig ma/ rna ba g.yas o ḍi yā nar pags pa dang dri ma 'bab pa'i rtsa keng rus can dang 'od ldan ma| ltag pa arbu tar sha 'bab pa'i rtsa g.yon pa ma mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma ste gnas so// rna ba g.yon gau da wa rir rgyus pa 'bab pa'i rtsa thung ngu ma lha dgra dang dpa' mo'i blo can ma/ smin mtshams ra me shwa rar rus pa 'bab pa'i rtsa rus sbal skyes ma 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis de wī ko ṭar mchin pa 'bab pa'i rtsa sgom pa ma rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis ma la war snying gi sha 'bab pa'i rtsa dbang ma rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas so// de ltar thugs kyi 'khor lo na mkha' spyod pa'i lha bcu drug po sku mdog sngon po'o// mchan khung gnyis ka ma rū par mig 'bras kyi sha 'bab pa'i rtsa skyon ma myu gu can dang sa srung ma/

nu ma gnyis o ṭer mkhris pa 'bab pa'i rtsa mjug ma rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing ngo*/ lte ba tri sha ku ner glo ba 'bab pa'i rtsa ma mo dpa' bo chen mo dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rgyu ma 'bab pa'i rtsa mtshan mo rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing ngo*// kha ka liṅkar lta zur gyi rgyus pa dang mnye ma 'bab pa'i rtsa bsil sbyin ma rab tu bzang po dang sngo bsangs lha mo/ mgrin pa laṃ bā kar lto ba 'bab pa'i rtsa tsha ba ma rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo ste tshandho ha'o// snying kañtsir bshang ba 'bab pa'i rtsa gzhol ma 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ 'doms bar gyi 'bras bu hi mā la yar mtshog ma'i mtshams mtha' dang gzhung pa 'bab pa'am rtsa rangs ma mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste nye ba'i tshandho ha'o// de ltar gsung gi 'khor lo sa la spyod pa'i lha bcu drug po sku mdog dmar po'o// mtshan ma pre ta pu rir bad kan 'bab pa'i rtsa gzugs can ma stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma/ bshang lam gṛ ha de war rnag 'bab pa'i rtsa thun mong ma rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma ste 'du ba'o// brla gnyis sau rāṣṭar khrag 'bab pa'i rtsa rgyu sbyin ma rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ byin pa gnyis su warṇa dwīpar rngul 'bab pa'i rtsa sbyor bral ma nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba'o// sor mo bcu drug nā ga rar tshil 'bab pa'i rtsa sdug gu ma dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong gnyis sindhur mchi ma 'bab pa'i rtsa grub ma padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod do// mthe bong bzhi ma rur tshil ma 'bab pa'i rtsa 'tshed ma rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis ku lu tar snabs 'bab pa'i rtsa yid bzang ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod do// de ltar sku'i 'khor lo sa 'og la spyod pa'i lha bcu drug po sku mdog dkar po'o// de ltar dpa' bo nyer bzhi po thams cad kyang zhal gcig

/spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ ral pa'i thor gtsug can/ rin po che la sogs pa'i rgyan dang ldan zhing dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcings pa/ rdo rje'i phreng bas sbrel ba'i thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs can/ rnal 'byor ma nyer bzhi po'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum ma/ phyogs kyi gos can skra grol ba rdo rjes sbrel ba'i thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can phyag g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas gri gug 'phyar ba gcer mo drag po'i gzugs can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing 'og pag sil sil gyi sgra sgrog pa/ zhabs byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khril bas snyoms 'jug gi bde ba dang bcas pa'o// snying ga'i phyi rol gyi rtsa 'dab brgyad dang hūm̐ ring po brgyad gnyis su med pa las shar du kha dang lte bar 'brel ba'i rtsa kha gdong ma sngon mo/ byang du sna bug g.yon dang 'brel ba'i rtsa 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ nub tu bshang gci'i lam dang 'brel ba'i rtsa khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lhor sna bug g.yas dang 'brel ba'i rtsa phag gdong ma ser mo/ mer rna ba g.yas kyi bu ga dang 'brel ba'i rtsa gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ bden bral du rna ba g.yon gyi bu ga dang 'brel ba'i rtsa gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ rlung du mig g.yas dang 'brel ba'i rtsa gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ dbang ldan du mig g.yon dang 'brel ba'i rtsa gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ de ltar dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i lha mo brgyad ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas gnas pa/ zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga dang ldan pa/

rgyan cha lugs snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi ltar gsal bar gyur/ ces bsgom mo// de ltar yang*/ snying ga'i gtso bo yab yum la lus kyi lha yab yum thams cad nye bar gzigs par bsam dgos shing*/ kha cig thog mar lha'i dmigs pa gsal bar mi nus pas thog mar rtsa so so dang de dag gi sa bon gsal bar bsgoms la rim gyis lha gsal btab bo// rtsa khams rnams ngo bo nyid kyis lhar dag pa'i nang gi rnal 'byor gdod nas yongs grub rmad du byung ba la mnyam par 'jog pa yang 'di dag gi shugs la nyams su len rigs par grub pa yin no// de ltar rnam pa gsal ba snang la rang bzhin ma grub par bsgoms nas/ gsum pa dag pa dran pa ni/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi ni mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'o// 'dun pa sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dad pa sogs dbang po lnga/ slar yang dad sogs stobs lnga/ ting 'dzin sogs byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ lta ba sogs yang dag pa bzhi ste/ nyer bzhi po ni dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams so// yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' sogs bzhi ni sgo ma bzhi'o| |dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams skyed pa sogs bzhi ni gshin rje bzhi'o// yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka rdo rje'o// shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o// zhes dag pa dran pa'i ngang nas nga rgyal brtan pa ni/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ bdag gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams dang*/ 'dzam bu gling na bzhugs pa'i sprul pa'i lha rnams dang*/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams dbyer med du gyur pas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyang thabs shes gnyis su med pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du dag pa nga'o// oṃ badzra shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥbadzra shuddho3haṃ/

zhes yun ring du bsgom mo// bzhi pa go cha bgo ba ni/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa padma la āḥdamar po/ snying khar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po/ bcom ldan 'das dang dpa' bo nyer bzhi'i snying gar oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swā hā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣaṭa he nag po/ mig gnyis su huṃ hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haṃ ljang gu/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dpa' mo nyer bzhi sgo mtshams ma brgyad rnams kyi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo/ snying khar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo/ khar hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo/ mgo bor hriṃ hrīṃ ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur par dmigs/ lnga pa ye shes pa dgug pa ni/ 'bar ba'i rgya smin mtshams su g.yo bas/ pheṃ/ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dang*/ dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ lcags kyu sogs bzhi'i rgyas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ lag gnyis rnam lnga 'dod kor dang 'khyud pa'i rgyas/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ chos thams cad thabs shes dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor du dag la bdag kyang de'i ngo bor dag go// zhes don dran par bya/ drug pa dbang bskur ba ni/ slar yang*/ ye shes pa dang lhan cig spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ badzra wī ṇi/ sogs rig ma bcu drug thog mthar/ oṃ dang hūm̐ phaṭa spangs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs skrod/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ yum bzhi phag mo dang bcas pas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas lha thams cad bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du gyur to/ zhes mos te bdun pa rgyas gdab pa ni/ chu lhag ma las bcom ldan 'das la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs 'khor gyi lha la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor gyi lha la 'od dpag med/ sku 'khor gyi lha la rnam snang*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la don grub kyis dbu brgyan dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ ces mos la/ brgyad pa phyi'i mchod pa ni/ sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i lha mo mchod rdzas 'dzin pa nam mkha'i khams kun nas gang bas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur bar dmigs nas/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes sogs chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang*/ rig ma bcu drug gi sngags rgyas mchod| dgu pa nang gi mchod pa ni/ srin lag g.yon pas bdud rtsi thigs gtor dbul zhing*/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse gsum pa'i sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bar gyur// oṃ a mṛ ta swā da swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

'phags mchog klu sgrub snying po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grub chen dril bu zhabs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grub chen dzā landha ra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnal 'byor nag po spyod pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tilli shes rab bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nā ro ye shes dngos grub kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnal 'byor karṇa ri pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ paṇa chen a bha yā ka ra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal chen rga lo tsā ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcu gnyis pa rin chen rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ slob dpon dbang phyug bsod nams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhas grub grags pa shes rab kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun mkhyen tshul rgyal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mtshungs med grags pa rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gtsang pa blo gros bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhan chen rin chen bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun bsod nams mtshan can gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun sna tshogs rang grol gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī badzra he he sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar sngags thams cad kyi mjug tu yi ge gsum btags pas mchod la/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā kā lī oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba dharma pā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ rang gis kyang myang*/ bcu pa gsang mchod ni| gtso bo la sogs pa he ru ka rnams kyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan pa bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/

rdo rje phag mo sogs rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa las a las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'brur as mtshan pa bde ba 'bab pa'i rtsa hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par slebs pas dga' ba/ de nas snying ga'i bar mchog dga'/ de nas lte ba'i bar khyad dga'/ de nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor son pas lha thams cad lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bar gyur/ ces dang 'khyud pa'i rgyas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes dmigs so// bcu gcig pa de bzhin nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ rang bzhin med pa'i gnas goms phyir// lha yi snying po sgom byed pa// de ni mchod pa chen por 'dod// sangs rgyas thams cad rtogs byed pa'o// zhes bde stong dbyer med kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag go// bcu gnyis pa sngags mchod ni/ yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying nas bzung sgo ma bzhi'i bar du 'og nas 'byung ba ltar lha so sor dmigs la brjod do// bcu gsum pa bstod pa ni/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ooṃ ma hā kalpāgni saṃ ni bha ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dzā ṭa ma ku ṭotka ṭā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ daṃ ṣṭ+wā ka ra lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa ra shu pā shodyā ta shū la kha ṭwāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ byā ghrā dzi nāṃ wa ra dha rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā dhū mrāndha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes yab dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badzra wā rā hī baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo ārya a pa rā dzi te trai lokya mā te ma hā bīdye shwa ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha yā wa he ma hā badzre huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ na mo badzra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa shyaṃ ka ri ni tra bhrā ma ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥtrā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzambha ni st+wambha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badzra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bstod/ bcu bzhi pa bgrang phreng ni/ mi'i thod pa las byas shing gzhon nu ma ma nyams pas bkal ba'i ras kyi srad bu la brgyus pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du bgrang phreng hrīḥlas padma gar dbang dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang pos padma dmar po/ gnyis pas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon dang pos dril bu/ gnyis pas thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ spyan gsum pa ral pa'i cod pan can/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod la/ oṃ padma narte shwa ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brgya sogs bzlas rjes/ padma gar dbang yongs su gyur pa las bgrang phreng gi rnam par gyur par dmigs/ bco lnga pa bzlas pa ni/ bdag he ru kar gnas pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba la rlung dang lhan cig tu rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas thon/ khams gsum gyi sems can lhar gsal ba'i sna bug g.yas par zhugs/ snying gar hūm̐ gnas pa la thim zhing*/ hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba sems can gyi sna bug g.yon pa nas thon/

rang gi sna bug g.yas par zhugs thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim zhing 'khor bar gyur ces dmigs/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa las so so ba dang*/ gzhan rgyas pa logs su rtogs par bya'o// de nas/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la samba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces yab kyi snying po dang nye snying ngo*// oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces yum gyi snying po dang nye snying ngo*// 'khor gyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ la rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor ba las slar sngags kyi rnam pa thon pa las 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs spros shing yang de nyid la thim par gyur par dmigs te/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes bde chen 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang*/ oṃ ka ra ka ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pra tsaṇḍe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ku ru ku ru huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsaṇḍa akṣi ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bhandha bhandha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pra bha wa ti ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ trā sa ya trā sa ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā nā se huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kṣo bha ya kṣo bha ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bī ra ma ti ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hroṃ hroṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kharba rī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hraḥhraḥhuṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ laṅke shwa rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ phaiṃ pheṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dru matstsha ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes thugs 'khor gyi lha bcu drug dang*/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ai rā ba tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ da ha da ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā bhai ra bī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ bā yu be ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa ba sa ru dhi rant+ra mā lā ba lambi nī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ| oṃ su ra bhakṣi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa sapta pā ta la ga ta bhu dzaṃ gaṃ sarbaṃ wā tardza ya tardza ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shyā mā de wī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā kaḍḍha a kaḍḍha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ su bha dra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ha ya karṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dzauṃṇa dzauṃṇa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kha gā na ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes gsung 'khor gyi lha bcu drug dang*/ oṃ kṣ+maṃ kṣ+maṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ tsakra be ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hāṃ hāṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hīṃ hīṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shauṇḍa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsakra warmi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ki li ki li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ| oṃ su bī rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ si li si li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā ba le huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hi li hi li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tsakra warti nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dhi li dhi li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā bīrye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes sku 'khor gyi lha bcu drug dang*/ oṃ ka kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ullu ka sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shwa na sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sū ka rā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dā dhī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dū ti ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣṭi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma mā thā nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad do// de ltar bshad ma thag pa bzlas shing*| spro na yab yum gyi go cha gnyis dang*/ rtsa ba'i sngags rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyang bzla'o// de yang grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni/ rab gtso bo la 'bum/ 'khor lo lnga so sor khri/ 'bring gtso bo la khri/

'khor lo lngar stong*/ tha ma gtso bo la stong*/ 'khor lo lngar brgya sogs so// dus kyi bsnyen pa ni/ rab zla ba drug 'bring zla ba gsum/ tha ma zhag bdun no// mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa ni/ rab yi dam dang dngos su mjal ba'i rdor dril nam mkhar 'jog nus pa/ 'bring bdud rtsi khol ba dang du ba sogs rtags bcu mthong ba/ tha ma sems dag pa dang rmi lam du gnang ba thob pa'o// de yang mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa gsum dang*/ grangs dus kyi rab 'bring bzhi ste bdun pos gzhi bsnyen gyi go chod la/ grangs dus kyi tha ma gnyis ni bsnyen pa kha gso tsam las min no// bsnyen pa thems nas kha skong la zhi ba dang*/ lha tshim pa'i slad du rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dag bya zhing slob dpon du 'os pa la ni ye shes dbab pa'i sngags khri phrag gcig nges par bzla dgos so// de ltar bskyed rim bzlas pa dang bcas pa yang rdzogs rim dang zung du sbrel dgos pa rdo rje theg pa'i zab lam ste/ bcu drug pa rdzogs rim 'od gsal bar 'jug cing lha sku sgyu ma lta bur ldang ba ni/ rang gi ngag tu ā di kā di brjod pas sna bug g.yas nas 'gro ba'i rlung ā di kā di 'od 'phro ba las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros/ 'gro ba rnams lhar byas/ gdod ma nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dang ro gcig tu byas/ rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs lte bar ā di kā di las grub pa'i zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ dkar dmar gsal ba'i zla ba hūm̐ bcas yongs su gyur pa las/ he ru ka dkar po rdor dril 'dzin pas phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa dag snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras 'gro ba rnams bkug pa de srung 'khor la thim/ de dam tshig gi 'khor lo la/ de sku 'khor la/ de gsung 'khor la/ de thugs 'khor la/ de bde chen 'khor lo la/ bde chen 'khor lo'i lha mo bzhi gtso bo'i zhal bzhi la/

gtso bo yab yum yang lte ba'i lhan skyes la/ de snyoms 'jug gi chags pas zhu ba sindhu ras byugs pa'i mu tig lta bu'i hūm̐ yig la/ de yang ū yig khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da/ de yang je phrar song ste skra'i rtse mo brgya stong gi cha tsam du yun ring du bsgom/ mthar de yang mi dmigs pa'i 'od gsal stong nyid mnyam par 'jog pa la 'jug cing*/ de las skad cig gis zung 'jug sgyu ma lta bu 'khor lo lnga lus dkyil du skad cig gis lam gyis ldang ba la dus dang yun du bslab pa shin tu gal che'o// 'di dag bsdus pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ rgyas pa ni dril bu rim lnga ltar nyams su blang ngo*// bzlas pa ni/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gyis ngal na bya bar bshad pas skabs 'dir bya dgos so// gong du bshad pa ni sa bcad tsam du byas so// bzlas pa ni skyon drug dang bral ba'i mi smra ba thun du bcad pa nges par dgos kyi bab col gyis ni nam du yang ma yin no// bcu bdun pa thun mthar bsdu chog bya ba ni/ lha rnams yab yum snyoms 'jug gi sgras snying ga'i gtso bo yab yum/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ 'khor lo gsum/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang bcas pa so so'i gnas su thim par gyur/ rang nyid phyi'i he ru ka zhal phyag yongs rdzogs yab yum yang snyoms par zhugs pas he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis yum dang bcas pa lhan skyes g.yas brkyang gi gar gyis bzhugs par gyur/ ces dang*/ yab yum gyi go cha gnyis dang*/ lag pa g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub spyi bor g.yon du bskor zhing*/ slar phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor du lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis se gol dang zhal bzhi'i sngags kyis kyang bsrung ngo*// de ltar na phyi rol gyi 'gro ba thams cad gdod ma nas yongs grub kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i sku dang*/ zin pa dang ma zin pa'i sgra thams cad rkang pa brgyad sogs sngags kyi sgra kho nar blta bar bya'o// gnyis pa yan lag la gnyis/

rnal 'byor bdun bshad pa dang*/ thun snga phyi'i bar ji ltar bya ba bshad pa'o// dang po la/ gtor ma gtang ba/ smon lam gdab pa/ spyod lam/ kha zas/ khrus/ nyal ba/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor dang bdun no// dang po la gnyis/ 'das pa'i dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i'o// dang po ni/ sngar bshad pa lta bu'i gtor ma la chu dang bdud rtsi bran la/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ gtor mgron phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams spyan drangs/ rnam lnga 'dod kor bya zhing*/ mkha' 'gro ma dra ba sdom pa'i bde ba sa ma ya st+waṃ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes dang*/ slar| sa ma ya st+waṃ can sngags tshan gnyis lan gnyis brjod/ thal mo gnyis gyen du bkan la/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du ā di las zla ba/ g.yas par kā di las nyi mar gyur pa'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tā sarba dharmaḥpa ramba ra a nu pra wiṣṭaḥsarba dharmaḥ.adyanta a nu pra wiṣṭaḥsarba dharmaḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zla nyi sa bon yongs su gyur pa'i rdo rje'i thal mos gtor ma bteg par gyur/ ces mos la thod pa'i rgyas/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*/ /des gsungs tshig kyang mchog tu tshad ma ste/ /bden pa de yis lha mo mchog gis ni| |bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /mgron rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar dmigs la/ auṃ badzra ā ralli hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya hoḥ zhes pa'i hoḥgong ma yan la pad kor dang*/ dzaḥcan bzhir lcags kyu sogs so so'i rgya dang*/ badzra nas st+waṃ gyi bar la thod pa'i rgya dang*/ dṛ shya hoḥl se gol bya ste/ de 'dra ba'i sngags rgya lan bdun gyis 'khor lo lnga'i lha rnams la phul bas tshims par mos la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/

sogs chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mos mchod| he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// zhes pa nas/ kun la bdag ni gus phyag 'tshal gyi bar sho lo ka gnyis kyis bstod pa'i mjug tu/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam par chags pa bcom zhing kun tu rtog pa 'joms| |khyod kyis dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan// mgon po thugs rje'i chu yi dpyid kyis rlan par gyur pa'i thugs kyi chus// bdag la mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma la chu dang nang mchod bran la/ nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ dbang po la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ 'gugs pa'i rgyas/ ind+ra/ ya ma/ ba ru ṇa/ ku be ra/ ma hā bhū ta/ agni/ rākṣa sa/ bā yu de wa ta/ tsand+ra/ sūrya/ brahma/ ādya de wa| be ma tsi tri/ pṛ thi wī de wa ta sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes dang*/ slar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ saṃ tṛpta sarba de wa ta sā dha ka sya shāntiṃ ku ru/ puṣṭiṃ ku ru/ sarba karyantu siddhirbaha wantu ya thā su khaṃ su kheḥ zhes spyan drangs pa sde brgyad mchog gi lha'i rnam par gyur par mos la/ oṃ da sha diklo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod la/ rdor thal kha phye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa/ rākṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ unmā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇantu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra yatstshantu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi ghra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shuddha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sngags tshar gsum dang*/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ lha yi tshogs rnams nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod kyi bar bya/ gtor ma gtsang sar dor/

de nas rdo rje snying gar bzung dril bu gnas brgyad du bskyod cing gsil la he ru ka'i yig brgyas 'das ma 'das thun mong du bzod gsol bya| lag gnyis ba dan gsum pa'i rgyas pad kor 'khyud tshul gyis/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes dang*/ slar mtheb srin gyis se gol bya zhing*/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// ji lta'i rjes mthun dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badzra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang rang gi gnas su gshegs| ye shes pa rnams rang la thim par gyur bar mos so/ /gnyis pa smon lam gdab pa ni/ rdor thal snying gar bzhag la/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang mchog tu tshad ma ste| |bden pa de yis lha mo mchog gis ni// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bde ba phun tshogs yang dag ldan// nad med dge ba'i sems dang ni// 'dod dang thar sogs yang dag thob// phun sum tshogs pa 'grub gyur cig /dge ba 'di yis khams gsum sems can kun// sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs nas// bcom ldan he ru ka dpal sku gsung thugs// ye shes yon tan phrin las mchog grub shog /ces so// gsum pa spyod lam ni/ dus dang yun du khams gsum po'i snod bcud thams cad 'khyer so gsum ldan du bya zhing*/ 'dod yon thams cad rang bde mchog gi nga rgyal gyis kha na ma tho ba spangs la longs spyad/ ngag tu dbyangs gsal ci nus brjod cing sems ting nge 'dzin la gnas par bya'o// bzhi pa kha zas ni/ skad cig gis lus dkyil gsal btab/ kha zas nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs| oṃ sa ma ya shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥs ma ya shuddho3haṃ/ zhes chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mos la/ lce hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse gcig pa dkar por bsam la/ oṃ a mṛ tod ka hūm̐ hūm̐ ṭha ṭhaḥ

trāṃ aṃ khaṃ hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ lte bar gtum mo'i me 'bar ba'i dbus su 'khor lo lnga'i lha bskyed la/ lag g.yon blugs gzar du mos la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis longs spyad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod la lha thams cad tshim par bsam/ lhag ma cung zad a kā ro'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ utstshiṣṭa'i sngags kyis 'byung po 'chol pa la sbyin no// lnga pa khrus ni/ chu dbang gi skabs ltar bya'o// drug pa nyal ba'i tshe/ sngar ltar snod bcud lus dkyil dang bcas pa rim gyis bsdus pa nā da la thim/ de yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas 'od gsal ba'i gdams pas gnad du bsnun la nyal lo// bdun pa ldang ba'i tshe/ tho rangs kyi dus dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi rdo rje'i glus bskul bas sad par dmigs pa'am/ yang na yig bdun gyi sgras sad par mos la bde mchog gi nga rgyal gyis ldang ngo*// gnyis pa thun mtshams ni/ thun dang po la nang mchod byin brlabs nas smon lam gyi bar bshad ma thag pa ltar bya zhing*/ thun gzhan rnams la skad cig ma'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor rnams wal gyis bsams nas sngags bzla zhing*/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel du bsgom zhing smon lam gyi bar bya/ thun bzhi gar gtor ma gnyis grub na legs shing*/ tshogs ni thun tha ma nyid la bya/ thun thams cad du bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi ngang nas bzlas pa smra bcad bag dang bcas pa skyon drug spangs pa kho na bya dgos so// gsum pa mjug ni/ nang gi sbyin sreg tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya ba dang*/ drod thob nas spyod pa spyad pa'i skabs so// dang po ni/ sngar bshad pa'i gtor ma'i rgyu lta bu'i tshogs rdzas sna tshogs pa ma da na dang bcas pa 'du byas la/ lag pa g.yon du 'bru tshom dbus dang mthar lnga bkod la/ lag pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lag mthil padma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar oṃ baṃ mdun nas g.yon skor du/ haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/

hriṃ hrīṃ/ huṃ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces dang*/ mthe bong la sogs pa lnga dang*/ sen mo rnams la rim pa bzhin/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bau ṣaṭa he/ huṃ hūm̐ hoḥ phaṭa haṃ/ rnams go cha'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i rang bzhin bol du lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor sor mo me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal ba'i khams lnga lha mo lngar gsal bar gyur/ oṃ badzra puṣpaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis dang yi ge gsum brjod/ sngar gyi sngags kyis sha zan dang nang mchod thigs gtor gyis mchod/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ lag pa'i lha rnams rang la thim par gyur par dmigs/ tshogs rdzas rnams nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ tshogs mgron spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// bcom ldan bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang*// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// sprul pa brgyad 'gyed tilli pa// puṣpa ha ri'i dgon pa nas// dpal ldan grub chen nā ro pa// gro bo lung gi gnas mchog nas// rje btsun chen po lho brag pa// mthon mthing rgyal mo'i zur phud nas/ */rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la'i zhabs// dwags lha sgam po'i dgon pa nas// mnyam med dam pa rin po che// kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod nas// 'gro ba'i mgon po rdo rje rgyal/ */ 'bri gung dpal gyi pho brang nas// rgyal pa'i dbang po ratna shrī// dag pa phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas// rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa'i tshogs// 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas// bcom ldan 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas// ma bzhin brtse ba'i mkha' 'gro dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor nas// bar chad sel ba'i chos skyong rnams| |mos gus gdung bas spyan 'dren na// sngon gyi thugs dam dgongs mdzod la// rang bzhin dbyings nas sku bzhengs nas// sgrub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir// rnal 'byor gdung bas spyan 'dren gshegs// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas gshegs nas kyang*// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i/

/sgrub pa po la dngos grub zhu/ /sa gzhi bkra shis mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ slar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ kye/ tshogs khang pho brang gzhal yas 'di// o rgyan gnas su byin gyis rlobs// 'dir tshogs tshogs mgron thams cad kun// dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs// rin chen la sogs sna tshogs snod// padma bhañdzar byin gyis rlobs// bcud kyi tshogs 'khor rgya chen 'di// ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// 'bras rgun bu ram bcos pa'i chang*// shes rab ma da na mchod 'di// dbang bzhi bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas dbang bzhi'i don rtogs shog */ ba la sha lnga 'bras khur dang*// thabs chen maṃ sa'i mchod pa 'di// rtog med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas chos sku thob par shog /dbang po lnga dang bcas pa yi// sna tshogs keng rus mchod pa 'di// bde stong bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas longs sku thob par shog /byang sems rkang dang khu ba zhag /ga ṇa rakta'i longs spyod 'di// gsal stong bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas sprul sku thob par shog /zho sha la sogs dam tshig rdzas// pañtsa a mṛ ta mchod 'di// dam tshig bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas bslab gsum don rtogs shog /bu raṃ la sogs mngar gsum dang*// dkar gsum arghaṃ mchod pa 'di// zag med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas skye med don rtogs shog /'dod yon phyi nang gsang mchod rnams// rigs lnga'i bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas 'khor dang myang 'das kyi// yon tan rin chen thob gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod pa oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis// zhe sdang las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// dkar la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// bde chen sku ru 'gyur ba'i rdzas// spyad pas rin chen chos sku la// nyams rtogs dbyer med 'brel gyur cig

/mnar sems zhe sdang 'khrug pa kun// byams pa chen por 'gyur bar shog /brjod pa āḥyi 'od zer gyis// 'dod chags las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// dmar la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// 'gag med gsung sgra sgrog pa'i rdzas// spyad pas gsung dbyangs drug cu yis// gdul bya ma lus tshim gyur cig /zag bcas bde ba'i nyams myong kun| |zag med bde bar 'gyur bar shog /brjod pa hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis// gti mug las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// mthing la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// gnyis med chos skur 'gyur bar shog /spyad pas sems rgyun ye shes lnga// rgyun chad med par 'brel gyur cig /rmongs shing ma rig gti mug tshogs// 'od gsal chen por 'gyur bar shog /mkhyen pa'i ye shes lnga ldan pa'i// rtog bral bdud rtsi'i tshogs 'khor 'di// lnga rdzogs bdud rtsi yin pa'i phyir// bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang la sogs// dus gsum bde gshegs dpa' bo dang*/ */phyi nang mkha' 'gros bzhes su gsol/ */a la la te dgyes par mdzod/ */rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpa' bo dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa yis| |bdag cag 'dir 'dus thams cad kyi// lus ngag yid gsum thams cad dang*// phung po khams dang skye mched la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// lus sprul sku sangs rgyas su byin gyis rlobs// ngag longs spyod rdzogs skur byin gyis rlobs// sems gnyis med chos skur byin gyis rlobs// sku gsum ma thob bar du yang*// phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa yis// phyi yi bar chad phyi ru sol// nang gi bar chad nang du sol// mchog thun dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes brjod cing*/ tshogs phud 'bul zhing nang mchod bran/ las kyi rdo rjes g.yas ma da na'i snod thogs/ g.yon ba dan gsum pa'i rgya bstan la/

mthong ba'i chos ni dag pa la// med do snyam pa'i rtog pa thong*| |bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag /lhan cig gcig pa nyid du gsol// zhes slob dpon la drangs/ slob dpon gyis kyang g.yon pas rgya de nyid dang g.yas pas blangs la/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med| |'dod chags dri ma dang bral zhing*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// de nyid la ni gus pas 'dud// ces dang*/ rdo rje'i glu ni/ bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol// rnal 'byor ma mchog padma'i bde// a la la la la la hoḥ /dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba'i mchog /rnal 'byor ma tshogs mchod par mdzod// a i' ā ā ra li hoḥ /rab dgyes mgon po dgyes bzhugs mdzod// mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde ba gsol// dgyes pa'i bde ba gsol bar mdzod// zhi ba'i gar gyis gar mdzad pa// bdag la bde chen bde bar stsol// thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod// a la la la la la hoḥ /bde ba spangs pas grol mi 'gyur// bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol// bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas// chags pa'i dngos por khyod ma gyur// bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod// padma rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis// bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod// ces brjod cing*/ bde ba phun tshogs yang dag ldan/ */nad med dge ba'i sems dang ni// 'dod dang thar sogs yang dag thob// phun sum tshogs pa 'grub gyur cig /ces smon lam btab/ de nas bag dang bcas pas zas kyi rnal 'byor ltar longs spyad/ lhag ma bsdus pas slob dpon gyis mtheb mdzub rtse sprad/ lhag ma brkyangs pa kha'i thad du khyer ba'i dbus nas chang gi kha phru btab la/ rol mo dang bcas pas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ utstshiṣṭa bhakṣe bhyaḥswā hā/ zhes 'byung po 'chol ba rnams la sbyin no// gnyis pa ni/ bskyed rdzogs kyi drod thob nas/ kha ṭwāṃ ga bde ba chen po zhal phyag gi rnam pa spangs pa'i lha'i sku dang*/

ḍā ma ru shes rab stong pa nyid kyi sgra sgrog pa/ thod pa de nyid 'dus pa'i bde ba skyong ba/ tshangs skud rnam par mi rtog pa 'chang zhing*/ nyin mo snang ba thabs bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can te/ mtshan mo ni shes rab stong pa nyid rnal 'byor mar rtogs par bya zhing*/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi don dran pa'i ngang nas spyod lam blang dor dang bral bas rang gzhan gyi don 'bad med du bsgrub par bya zhing*/ de yang 'jigs pa thams cad spangs shing nyan rang gi lta spyod las ldog pas seng ge ltar gang la yang bag tsha ba spangs la brtul zhugs mchog gi spyod pa la gzhol bar bya'o// de ltar byas pas myang 'das chos kyi sku las gzugs sku dpa' bo rnams 'byung zhing*/ yid dag pa he ru ka nyid/ de'i yul chos phag mo'i gzugs su shar ba yan lag bdun ldan dpal he ru ka rdo rje 'chang mngon du byed la/ gal te tshe 'dir mchog ma grub kyang 'chi 'pho'i tshe dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis mkha' spyod du 'khrid par gdon mi za'o// 'on kyang rdo rje theg pa'i skal pa dang ldan zhing brtson pa phul du byung ba'i gang zag shin tu dkon pa nyid du zad do/ /smras pa/ gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab dpyid// 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam srol ma nyams pa// rnal 'byor ma tshogs yab gyur dril zhabs kyi// ring lugs gsal po bshad 'di kho bos byas// 'ga' zhig lū nag dril gsum dgongs pa'i dpyid/ bskyed rdzogs rnam par dbye ba ma rtogs par// 'jol nyog tsham tshom bskyed rdzogs gzhung lugs 'ga'// kho bos mthong yang de dang 'di mi mnyam// de ltar dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi lus dkyil mdor bsdus pa dril bu zhabs kyi zhal lung zhes bya ba 'di'ang rang nyid nyams su blang ba dang*/ blo dman rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i slad du/ grub chen dril bu zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i dril bu gzhung gsum du grags pa'i ya gyal sgrub thabs lo tsā ba mal jo blo gros grags kyis bsgyur pa nyid gzhir byas shing*/

rje zhwa dmar ba bzhi pas mdzad pa'i lus dkyil sogs bod kyi khungs thub rnams kyis kyang mtha' bcad de/ slar 'dzin bde ba'i slad du cho ga'i yan lag rnams rje btsun sna tshogs rang grol gyis mdzad pa'i lha lnga'i dkyil chog gi tshig cha nyid kyis kha bskangs nas/ gzu bor gnas pa'i blos bkod pa 'di'ang lam 'di nyid la goms pa'i rnal 'byor pa rdo rje 'dzin pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes 'bod pa dag gis/ shing glang tha skar can gyi dkar phyogs kyi bzang po gsum pa'i tshes la chu klung nā gardzu na'i sgra 'byin pa'i ngogs gzhu spro lung gi kun dga' ra bar sbyar ba'o// //maṅgalaṃ//
